body:
# Roses are Better | Resource Pack
Made by [**8bitdino**](https://www.youtube.com/@8bitdino) with **100% human-made** sprites :3
## Description
> Poppies are red, Roses are better, this texture pack fixes things down to the letter!

This texture pack changes Poppies to their original Rose texture (and name) with the updated Poppy colors. This also revamps the "Meditative" painting to look more accurate to the OG Rose, and changes the Wither Rose's texture to be in line with the OG Rose.
## Changed Textures
- Poppy (renamed "Rose")
- "Meditative" Painting
- Wither Rose
## IMPORTANT
This resource pack also renames "Poppy" to "Rose" in the following in-game languages:
- **Anglish** (Oned Riches)
- **English** (AUS, CAN, NZ, UK/GB, & US)
- **ɥsᴉꞁᵷuƎ** (uʍoᗡ ǝpᴉsd∩)
- **LOLCAT** (Kingdom of Cats)
- **Pirate Speak** (The Seven Seas)
- **Quenya** (Arda) from LOTR
- **tlhIngan Hol** (tlhIngan wo') from Star Trek

I debated adding support for all languages, but I am a singular, monolingual person, and there are upwards of 142 languages available in this game. I figured most people that find my resource packs will speak English, given that that's the language I upload in, so I only did the various English lanuages, plus a few "fun" ones.
> **Shakespearean English** was not in need of change.
## Credits
Made by **8bitdino**

Please credit me if you use my "**Meditative**" Painting texture in anything!
